B0: Exact S2 original PTS and bytes for retained goals. Run the same S2 mechanism for new sources.
B1: For a publicly requested single view, read candidate pixels and test a directly observable footprint against the temporal median; use compact relative foreground with supported edges or a nominated local region with measurable detail. A fastener/bottle shape condition applies only to named local-object queries. Choose a readable candidate only if visible support is measured, otherwise abstain. Other B1 routes retain S2.
B2: Protect distinct view states within independent time entrances and projected ball/context observations for the public recurrence target. For named recurrence on an archive without local nominations, inspect coarse original pixels and return a witnessed foreground peak per isolated occurrence, with actual source PTS. Keep S2 evidence and prior-state boundary. Do not partition a physical identity. No fixed count of regions, deliverables or windows.
B3: Independent B1/B2 mechanisms together; a single-view question does not activate a cross-time offer.
U_global: First-to-last eligible PTS, frozen nearest monotonic unique frame phase, n=1 temporal midpoint. Count-only after actual delivery.
U_public_scope: Identical source and n. A publicly specified late-only request is the last third of its public duration. Otherwise full public source range, with explicit no-narrowing reason. A global recurrence request never has its windows inferred from E0.
E0: No all-frame utility census or negative labels for unjudged. Independently sealed original-image roles, early acquisition, complementary role sets and concrete failure attribution. Do not equate verified local observation with contact, identity or absence.
receiver: Real local native-PNG payload receiver; no model inference or SDK acknowledgement is necessary. The historical user-excluded source is prohibited.
